Use `snl macro-package remove-member` to remove one Macro from an existing Macro Package through guarded membership management.

### Availability
This Entry is a normative product contract. The command is implemented only when its canonical path appears in machine-readable `snl --help`; absence means planned and unavailable, never silently emulated through a different command.


### Command path
`macro-package/remove-member` is the canonical transport-neutral command. The intended shell spelling is `snl macro-package remove-member`. Current availability is advertised by machine-readable `snl --help`; an Agent/MCP adapter submits the same operation object instead of reconstructing shell text.

### Operation request
```json
{"protocol":"snl.operation/v1","command":"macro-package/remove-member","root":"/absolute/workspace","arguments":{"id":"<exact-package-id>","member":"<exact-macro-id>","expectedPackageRevision":"<opaque>","expectedMemberRevision":"<opaque>"}}
```
Every adapter accepts exactly this semantic request. Unknown argument keys are rejected. The CLI accepts `--root` and `--json` globally and emits one complete JSON document followed by a newline. Duplicate add, absent remove, wrong owner, stale package revision, or stale member revision is a conflict with unchanged state. The two expected revisions explicitly protect the membership authority and member ownership authority.

### Success result
A successful call exits `0` and returns `{"protocol":"snl.result/v1","ok":true,"command":"macro-package/remove-member","data":{},"diagnostics":[]}`. `data` contains package and member canonical readbacks plus resulting revisions.

### Failure and exit semantics
Domain rejection (invalid data, not-found, conflict, or validation errors) exits `1`. Invocation, input I/O, unsupported workspace/schema, lock acquisition, and runtime failures exit `2`. Failure stdout under `--json` is exactly one `{"protocol":"snl.result/v1","ok":false,"command":"macro-package/remove-member","error":{"code":"<stable-code>","message":"<actionable text>","details":{},"retryable":false}}`; no stack trace or prose contaminates stdout.

### State and concurrency
Mutating. Change package membership and member ownership together under one lock with guarded rollback. Revisions, cursors, checked digests, and workspace revisions are opaque tokens. After success, canonical readback and whole-workspace validation must observe the published state.
